download_gwilliams2022_dataset: download the Gwilliams 2022 MEG dataset from OSF using Gwilliams2022Recording.download()
iterate_gwilliams2022_recordings: iterate over all Gwilliams 2022 MEG recordings using Gwilliams2022Recording.iter() to yield each recording
create_gwilliams2022_recording: create a Gwilliams2022Recording instance for a specific subject, session, and story identifier
load_raw_meg_data: load raw MEG data from a BIDS path using Gwilliams2022Recording._load_raw() and pick MEG channels
load_events_dataframe: load and parse MEG event annotations into a pandas DataFrame using Gwilliams2022Recording._load_events()
